text: M10 m10ws000 describes `m10-plan-updated` as a `powiadomienie` reaction with trigger `prymityw`, order `after: [capture]`, emitting `plan:updated { planPath, threadId, version, changedBy }`. Two things in code predate the window and differ: (1) M40's runtime ranks `notification` BEFORE `capture` (PHASE_RANK in src/server/fs/watcher.ts) and refuses a dependency on a later phase, so a notification reaction cannot be ordered after capture; (2) `PlanService` writes plan files with `chain: false` (its `file_version` row carries a `change_summary` the capture phase cannot receive) and itself broadcasts `plan:updated` after its own `recordVersion` (src/server/services/plan.ts). The build keeps that: the `plan:updated` broadcast with author, provenance and the new version is made at the end of the service's own write chain, and the bound `m10-plan-updated` definition (markdown, requires `m17-capture`, selected by the `plans` kind) no longer fires on watcher events — an outside edit is announced by the base `file:changed { rootId: 'plans' }`, as the window says (src/server/fs/notifications.ts `planUpdatedNotifier`). An in-band chain run by another writer of a plan file only emits the coarse `plans:changed` list refresh, since the handler sees no version.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-0010 — `plan:updated` is broadcast by PlanService after its own capture; the bound `m10-plan-updated` handler skips watcher events and emits only `plans:changed` for in-band runs.
